15. （本小题满分13分）已知集合 $A=\left\{x\mid\frac{2-x}{x+2}>0\right\}$，$B=\{x\mid|x-1|>2\}$，$C=\{x\mid m-1<x<2m+1\}$。
(1) 求 $A\cap B$，$(\complement_R B)\cup A$；
(2) 若 $A\cap C=C$，求实数 $m$ 的取值范围。

handwritten_answer.text:
解：$\because A=\left\{x\mid\frac{2-x}{x+2}>0\right\}$
$\therefore A=\{x\mid-2<x<2\}$
$B=\{x\mid|x-1|>2\}$
$\therefore B=\{x\mid x<-1\text{ 或 }x>3\}$
$\therefore A\cap B=\{x\mid-2<x<-1\}$
$\therefore \complement_R B=\{x\mid-1\leq x\leq 3\}$
$(\complement_R B)\cup A=\{x\mid-2<x\leq 3\}$
(2) $\because A\cap C=C$
$\therefore C\subseteq A$
当 $C$ 为空集时
$m-1\geq 2m+1$
$-2\geq m$
若 $C$ 不为空时
$\begin{cases} m-1\geq-2 \\ 2m+1\leq 2 \end{cases}\Rightarrow\begin{cases} m\geq-1 \\ m\leq\frac{1}{2} \end{cases}$
即 $-1\leq m\leq\frac{1}{2}$
综上，$m$ 的取值范围为 $m\leq-2$ 或 $-1\leq m\leq\frac{1}{2}$。
handwritten_answer.evidence_note: C001 context and answer_detail_01 show the retained handwritten steps in the draft order: A={x|-2<x<2}, B={x|x<-1 or x>3}, A∩B={x|-2<x<-1}, (complement_R B)∪A={x|-2<x≤3}, then (2) C⊆A with empty-set case m-1≥2m+1 and non-empty case system m≥-1, m≤1/2, ending with the summary line m≤-2 or -1≤m≤1/2; the scribbled-out token before C⊆A is cancelled and correctly absent from the draft; red underline and red '10' are marker ink, not student content.

16. （本小题满分15分）已知 $a\in\mathbb{R}$，$p:\forall x\in\{x\mid 0\leq x\leq 1\}$，$a\leq x^2+1$；$q:\exists x_0\in\mathbb{R}$，$x_0^2+2ax_0-(2a-3)=0$。
(1) 若 $p$ 是真命题，求 $a$ 的最大值；
(2) 若 $p$ 为假命题且 $q$ 为真命题，求 $a$ 的取值范围。

handwritten_answer.text:
解：$\because p$ 为真命题
$\therefore$ 当 $x=1$ 时
$x^2+1$ 最大，
此时 $x^2+1=2$
$\therefore$ 有 $a\leq 2$
则 $a_{\max}=2$
(2) $\because p$ 为假命题
$\therefore \exists x\in\{x\mid 0\leq x\leq 1\}, a>x^2+1$
$\therefore a>(x^2+1)_{\max}$
$\therefore a>2$
$\because q$ 为真命题
$\therefore$ 在方程 $x_0^2+2ax_0-(2a-3)=0$ 时，
$\Delta=4a^2+4(2a-3)\geq 0$
即 $4a^2+8a-12\geq 0$
解得 $a\leq-3$ 或 $a\geq 1$
综上 $a$ 的取值范围为 $a\leq-3$ 或 $a>2$
handwritten_answer.evidence_note: C002 context and answer_detail_01 show both columns matching the draft: (1) p true ⇒ x=1, x²+1 max =2, a≤2, a_max=2; (2) p false ⇒ ∃x∈{x|0≤x≤1}, a>x²+1, a>(x²+1)max, a>2; q true ⇒ Δ=4a²+4(2a-3)≥0, i.e. 4a²+8a-12≥0 (top of C003), solved a≤-3 or a≥1, summary a≤-3 or a>2; red circling stroke is marker ink only.

handwritten_answer.text:
解：(1) $\because 0<x<2$
$\therefore 0<2x<4$
$\because 0<y<3$
$\therefore -3<-y<0$
$\therefore -3<2x-y<4$
(2) $\because x>3$
$\therefore x-3>0$
$\therefore 2x-6>0$
$\therefore 2x+\frac{4}{2x-6}$
$=2x-6+\frac{4}{2x-6}+6$
$\therefore 2x-6+\frac{4}{2x-6}+6\geq 2\sqrt{(2x-6)\cdot\frac{4}{2x-6}}+6$
即 $2x-6+\frac{4}{2x-6}+6\geq 10$
当且仅当 $2x-6=\frac{4}{2x-6}$ 时，等号可取
$\therefore \left(2x+\frac{4}{2x-6}\right)_{\min}=10$
(3) $\because 0<x<4$
$\therefore 4-x>0$
$8-2x>0$
$x(8-2x)=\frac{1}{2}\cdot 2x(8-2x)$
$\frac{1}{2}\cdot 2x(8-2x)\leq \left(\frac{2x+(8-2x)}{2}\right)^2\cdot\frac{1}{2}=8$
$x(8-2x)\leq 8$
$x(8-2x)_{\max}=8$
